advancement.mf.uncommon_flowers.title: Uncommon Flowers
advancement.mf.uncommon_flowers.descript: These flowers can give effects to players and mobs
advancement.mf.rare_flowers.title: Rare Flowers
advancement.mf.ore_flowers.title: Ore Flowers
advancement.mf.ore_flowers.description: These flowers can be used to craft seeds of ore crops
advancement.mf.epic_flowers.title: Epic Flowers
advancement.mf.sweet_alyssum: Emits a soft and pleasant light. Usually grows near rivers and oceans.
advancement.mf.gaillardia:
Burns the entities when stepped on.
Usually grows in the savanna.
advancement.mf.oriental_poppy:
Explodes when stepped on.
Usually grows in planes and forests.
advancement.mf.water_hemlock:
Poisons the entities when stepped on.
Usually grows in the waters of swamps.
advancement.mf.oenothera:
Hurts the entities when stepped on.
Usually grows in plains, forests, jungles.
advancement.mf.chrysanthemum:
Heals the entities when stepped on.
Usually grows in the forests.
advancement.mf.autumn_crocus:
Makes scary sounds.
Usually grows in the deep dark.
advancement.mf.black_eyed_susan:
Gives resistance to the entities when stepped on.
Usually grows in plains and savanna.
advancement.mf.coreopsis:
Gives luck to the entities when stepped on.
Usually grows in plains, swamp and forest.
advancement.mf.dahlia:
Gives strength to the players when hostile mobs in 8 block radius.
Usually grows in forest and windswept hills.
advancement.mf.lavender:
Relaxes the entities in 8 block radius.
Usually grows in savanna and desert.
advancement.mf.velvets:
Gradually turns the overworld blocks into nether blocks.
Usually grows in the nether.
advancement.mf.autumn_asters:
Steals items from ground and player inventory when stepped on.
Usually grows in the dark forest.
advancement.mf.bone_flower:
Grows crops in 3x3 radius.
Usually grows in deep dark and dripstone caves.
advancement.mf.trade_flower:
Trades bone meal for any flower from the mod,
chances are higher for rare flowers if you trade with floral meal.
Usually grows in deep dark and dripstone caves.
advancement.mf.jack_flower:
Turns light at night.
Usually grows in the taiga.
advancement.mf.root_of_the_worlds:
Teleports players to random world when stepped on.
Usually grows in the forest.
advancement.mf.ethereal_orchid:
When placed sets player spawn pos, have 3 lives to respawn player.
Usually grows on plains.
advancement.mf.dreadpetal:
Hostile mobs will avoid this flower in 5 block radius.
Usually grows in the windswept hills and forest.
advancement.mf.blindblossom:
Hostile mobs will go to flower without paying attention to others.
Usually grows in the savanna.
